intent: Adapt an authoritative Design Contract only within explicitly permitted free zones and tolerances.
steps: Load the Design Contract and list free_zones and tolerances
Refuse adaptations outside declared free zones
Preserve mandatory text, elements, navigation and states
Record each adaptation with the contract tolerance rule that permits it
Escalate design-system conflicts instead of choosing silently
invariants: Every allowed adaptation cites a Design Contract rule
Authoritative structure and content remain binding
